publication: Auth0 HTTP Request Flow Material Kit

claims.claim: The material kit contains at least 3 specific endpoint URLs, 5 required parameter definitions with types, and 2 callback shape schemas extracted from the Auth0 HTTP request documentation.

sources.title: Auth0 HTTP Request Flow Material Kit

source_facts_needed: Exact endpoint URLs for HTTP request configuration in Auth0 flows
Required parameters, their types, and whether they are required or optional for each endpoint
Callback shapes, response schemas, and authentication headers or tokens required for the HTTP request
